subject: MicroLedger onboarding: request for micro-PO routing and short-form intake
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire@microledger.com>
To: david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on onboarding: can we do invoice-only / micro-PO?

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — MicroLedger is excited about the latency advantages your hosted runtime gives for our audit summarization flow. We're ready to start a small pilot but have a quick procurement question.

We typically operate on monthly invoices for smaller vendors (under $2,000 per invoice). Our procurement team asked whether Redwood can accept an "invoice-only" path or a very lightweight micro-PO (micro-PO) that doesn't require a full PO setup. The pilot spend will be modest and intermittent (estimate $500–1,500/month).

What would you need from us to enable a short-form onboarding instead of the standard PO-first process? We can provide:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Proof of EIN and a W-9
- Short statement of work (1 page)

If there's a temporary approval path or a pilot policy we can follow, happy to sign a short agreement.

Attachment: microledger_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Claire Park
Head of Operations
MicroLedger

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@microledger.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding: can we do invoice-only / micro-PO?

Hi Claire — great to hear and glad the demo landed.

Short answer: probably yes for a scoped pilot. I'll loop in procurement and our billing lead to confirm the exact requirements, but common minimums are:
- Completed onboarding form (you attached it, thanks)
- Legal name + EIN / W-9
- A short SOW or statement of expected usage and monthly cap
- Accounts payable contact for invoicing

Priyom and Monica — can you confirm whether we can approve a temporary micro-PO / invoice-only pathway for MicroLedger (est. up to $2k/month) and what compliance checks we need on the vendor side? If approved, I can push a short DocuSign and track this as a pilot (deal_id ML-2026-0042).

Claire — we'll aim to resolve within 48 hours.

Cheers,
David Kim
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: david_kim@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding: can we do invoice-only / micro-PO?

David / team,

Thanks for the heads-up and Claire for the submission. We can support a controlled invoice-only / micro-PO pilot but will need to lock a few guardrails for risk and bookkeeping. Proposed conditions:

1) Eligibility & duration
- Pilot window: 3 months (with option to extend)
- Per-invoice cap: $2,000 USD
- Aggregate cap: $6,000 over the pilot period

2) Required vendor artifacts (to be attached to vendor record)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we have this)
- W-9 and EIN confirmation
- Primary AP contact + billing email address

3) Controls we will apply
- Account flag: "invoice-only - microPO-pilot" for AP routing
- Monthly spend review and rollback if fraud/charge anomalies
- No credit terms beyond Net 30 during the pilot

4) Compliance check
- Quick vendor risk check (third-party screening) — if red flags, pilot paused

I've drafted a short internal playbook for micro-POs outlining the steps for procurement and AP (attached). If David signs off, I'll prepare a DocuSign short-form commercial addendum for the pilot.

Attachment: micro-po-playbook-draft.docx (docx)

Priyom
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi David / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick reply and for outlining the guardrails. MicroLedger is comfortable with the proposed conditions and the pilot caps. A few clarifications:
- We will provide W-9 and a one-page SOW this afternoon.
- Can you confirm billing email for invoices (we typically send to billing@vendor.com)?
- DocuSign for the short-form addendum is perfect — please send when ready.

Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Tom Singh
CFO
